:::::: {#about-content}
### Hi, I'm Lennart! <span aria-hidden="true">&#x1F44B;&#x1F642;</span> {.typewriter-on-load}

<div style="text-align: justify">
I am currently a research associate in the [Econometrics Group](https://www.uni-bielefeld.de/fakultaeten/wirtschaftswissenschaften/lehrbereiche/econometrics/) at Bielefeld University and recently completed [my PhD](https://pub.uni-bielefeld.de/record/3014719). I like data science and math, [teaching both](https://blogs.uni-bielefeld.de/blog/wiwi/entry/andreas_handl_lehrpreis_2024_anerkennung), and developing open source software. In my spare time, you can find me [in front of a chessboard](https://sf-lieme.de/) or [above the clouds](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c2vc8qY3B5c).
</div>

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="minimal"}
## Research Interests

-   [Discrete choice models](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Discrete_choice), in particular preference heterogeneity and Bayesian estimation of latent class mixed multinomial probit models.
-   [Numerical optimization](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mathematical_optimization), in particular methods for efficient and robust initialization.
-   [Hidden Markov models](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hidden_Markov_model), in particular hierarchical extensions to improve trend detection in financial time series across different time scales.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="minimal"}
## Recent Talks

- [Faster and more robust maximum likelihood estimation for random utility models](files/icmc_01_04_2024.pdf), ICMC in Puerto Varas, April 1, 2024
- [Modeling unobserved choice behavior heterogeneity](files/yrw_16_02_2024.pdf), 13th YRW at Bielefeld University, February 16, 2024
- [Facilitating probit likelihood optimization](files/statwo_12_09_2023.pdf), Statistische Woche in Dortmund, September 12, 2023
- [Bayesian probit models for preference classification](files/IWSM2023-oelschlaeger-bauer-poster.pdf), IWSM in Dortmund, July 18, 2023
- [Initialization of numerical optimization in R](files/yrw_07_09_2023.pdf), 12th YRW at Bielefeld University, September 7, 2023
- [Advances in the initialization of probit model estimation and the {ino} R package](files/yrw_18_11_2022.pdf), 11th YRW at Bielefeld University, November 18, 2022
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="minimal"}
## Teaching

Several lectures and tutorials in statistics and math. See [here](https://ekvv.uni-bielefeld.de/kvv_publ/publ/Lehrende_Veranstaltungen.jsp?personId=188400676&zeigeAlle=1) for a complete list.
:::
